AfricaNenda Internship Program is a 6-month fully remote contract for early-career professionals to gain hands-on experience in Africa’s digital financial services and inclusive instant payment systems.

AfricaNenda Internship Program Abstract

  • Host: AfricaNenda Foundation

  • Location: Remote

  • Category: Internships || Trainings

  • Benefits:

    • Paid Internship

    • Flexibility

    • Exposure

    • Hands on experience

  • Eligibility: All Countries

  • Deadline: May 29, 2026

AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program Details

The AfricaNenda Foundation is an African-led organization created to accelerate the growth of inclusive instant payment systems (IIPS) that will benefit all Africans, including the poorest and currently financially excluded. AfricaNenda believes that IIPS can be pivotal in creating universal access to financial services for many financially excluded adults in Africa by 2030.

The 6-month full-time remote internship offers participants the opportunity to gain practical experience within Africa’s digital financial services ecosystem while supporting projects focused on inclusive instant payment systems across Africa.

Interns will work closely with the Projects team while gaining exposure to research, project coordination, reporting, advocacy support, stakeholder engagement, and campaign execution.

AfricaNenda Internship Program 2026 Scholarship Benefits

Interns in the AfricaNenda Internship Program will gain;

  • Paid internship opportunity

  • Remote work flexibility

  • Practical experience in digital financial services

  • Exposure to inclusive payment systems and financial inclusion projects

  • Project management and stakeholder engagement experience

  • Professional learning and development opportunity

  • Cross-functional collaboration exposure

Key Responsibilities for AfricaNenda Internship Program Interns

The Interns will be responsible for:

  • Conduct research and support analysis activities

  • Assist with presentations, reports, and advocacy materials

  • Support virtual and physical project engagements

  • Maintain project tracking tools and reporting systems

  • Support meeting documentation and follow-up activities

  • Maintain stakeholder databases and engagement records

  • Assist with campaign and cross-functional project activities

  • Support data tracking and organizational tasks

AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program Requirements

To be eligible for the AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:

  • Have a bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, International Relations, Social Sciences, or related field

  • Have strong research and analytical skills

  • Have excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Be proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • Have strong organizational and interpersonal abilities

  • Attention to detail and data management skills

  • Have Interest in financial inclusion and digital payments

  • Be Self-motivated and proactive

  • Adaptability and willingness to learn

  • Basic project management and reporting knowledge

  • Knowledge of social media and digital platforms

  • French language proficiency is an advantage

  • Portuguese language knowledge is an added advantage

AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program 2026 Required Documents

While applying for the AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program 2026, you will be required to submit the following documents;

  • Your updated CV

How To Apply for AfricaNenda Internship Program

To apply for the AfricaNenda Paid Remote Internship Program 2026, follow the instructions we have outlined below; 

  • Read the information we have provided on this webpage and ensure your eligibility

  • Prepare your CV

  • Please send in your CV highlighting relevant skills and experiences, including three referees through the applications@africanenda.org email.

  • Female candidates are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Only short-listed candidates shall be contacted.

Deadline: May 29th, 2026

APPLY HERE: https://africanenda.org/wp-content/uploads/AfricaNenda_Program-Support-Intern_May-2026.pdf
